test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The commander ordered the soldiers to march ahead and not to think of their enemy’s large numbers.

options.text: The commander said to the soldiers, “March ahead. Do not think of their enemy’s large numbers.”
The commander said to the soldiers, “March ahead and not think of their enemy’s large numbers.”
The commander said to the soldiers, “March ahead. Do not think of your enemy’s large numbers.”
The commander said to the soldiers, “Please march ahead. Do not think of your enemy’s large numbers.”

solution:
The correct answer is **The commander said to the soldiers, “March ahead. Do not think of your enemy’s large numbers.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an indirect speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting indirect speech into direct speech:​
 
 
• The commas and inverted commas are added, and 'ordered' is replaced by 'said to'.
 
• The third-person pronoun 'their' will be changed into the second-person pronoun 'your'.
 
• The to-infinitive (to think) is changed into the base form of the verb (think). Also, "not" is changed into "do not".
 
 
 
• From the following rules, we get the correct sentence as option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• You may think that the first option should be the correct option but in the option, the third person pronoun remains unchanged. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 3

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
